text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hat section: from 2 mm galvanized strip 84 mm wide, folded to two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 22 mm flanges, two 45 degree sides and a 16 mm wide top, 16 mm high

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: overall. Fold in a sheet folder; cut lengths with a grinder.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paint the cut ends with zinc paint; file all edges smooth.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 211 mm of hat section. At one end cut away the top and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sides for 42 mm, leaving the two flanges; fold the flanges up

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 90 degrees 30 mm from their ends to make the tabs (169 mm of raised part).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a 9 mm hole in each tab, 18 mm up, 32 mm from the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: lies across the gutter strip and 80 mm onto the grate's border,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: over the cable. The tabs go over the curb cover's flanges and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: share its two lower anchors (security nuts). Nothing is fixed to the road.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lies flat with no rocking.
